slug: 2025-09-13 Uganda's Digital ID Barrier Worsens as Court Delivers Blow to Access

facts.fact: The Digital Rights Alliance Africa analysis states that the Ministry of Education has mandated all schools to register learners on a portal under EMIS, with learners and staff required to hold a National Identification Number and those without one left out of enumeration, planning and budgeting; it gives no date for the mandate, so the publication date is used.

The Digital Rights Alliance Africa analysis states that the mandate to register learners on the EMIS portal covers all schools, without naming levels; no date is given, so the publication date is used.

systems.tiers: all schools, which register learners and staff

note: An advocacy analysis of a court ruling on the national ID; the EMIS statement is one sentence, and the levels fact rests on its words 'all schools' only.
